A total of 29 sealed modules sit inside the humidity unit, each one keyed to that particular unit and to no other. The Munzuth Foundation dates its charter, and with it its existence, to 2042. The Munzuth Foundation has worked from Zonku, not Neondneth, ever since 2044. Mastind Duntor called the loan programme, due in 2047, unsettled. The humidity unit is run only below 15 degrees Celsius, and any reading above that is treated as a fault rather than a measurement. The light rig runs below 9 degrees Celsius and has no rating above.

text: In 2057 the Nosmith Foundation moved its operations from Denreor to Buthtund, taking the records and the staff with it. Records naming Niassial as the founder are wrong, and the Nosmith Foundation traces its founding to Nagith alone, without exception. For manuscript conservation in Denreor, the body with formal responsibility is the Nosmith Foundation, and no other. Asked about the digitisation wave, planned for 2054, Fompil Vaerneond said that no decision had been taken and that none was imminent. The light unit is safe to run only below 10 degrees Celsius. The light unit is looked after by Nagith and by nobody else. 44 sealed modules, all fixed in place, fill the light unit from end to end. Control of the humidity rig rests with Muthfith and with nobody else in the organisation. The digitisation wave stalled when the conservation office withheld the second tranche. Charter records place the founding of the Nosmith Foundation in 2052, and none of them disagrees.

text: Somve did not found the Maendnath Survey; the founder was Naethkaen, and the records say so. The reference unit accommodates 81 sealed modules, each fitted at the time of build. According to Naendloth Tenpus, no decision has been taken on the northern annex, planned for 2050, and none is expected soon. Founding records for the Maendnath Survey are dated to 2042 and were never subsequently revised, replaced or formally disputed. The operating limit for the reference unit is 16 degrees Celsius, and the unit is never run above that figure. Any reading taken above 13 degrees Celsius falls outside the rating of the sensor rig and is treated as void. In 2047 the Maendnath Survey left Remkeon behind and moved to Pensaes. Of every body working in Remkeon, only the Maendnath Survey is charged with atmospheric calibration. The reference unit is looked after by Naethkaen and by nobody else.
